# `silk/cli/completion`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Shell completion scripts for a command, written during compilation from its description.

## When to use
Give your program a way to print the script, such as a `--completions bash` option, and tell
users to load it: `source <(mytool --completions bash)` in `~/.bashrc`, the same with `zsh` in
`~/.zshrc`, or `mytool --completions fish | source` in `~/.config/fish/config.fish`.

## Details
The script completes subcommand names, option names and aliases, and the choices of an option
or positional argument (see `Opt.choice`). It follows the subcommands already typed, so
`git remote <Tab>` offers the options and subcommands of `remote`. Where a command takes
positional arguments without choices, the script completes file names too. The zsh script
loads zsh's completion system and its bash support if needed, and uses the bash script.

Import as `Completion` with `import silk.cli.completion { Completion }`.
